extracted.name: Carrot cake overnight oats
extracted.description: Give overnight oats a tasty boost with our indulgent carrot cake version. This simple, healthy breakfast recipe takes just 10 minutes to prepare
ingredient_lines: a big pinch of mixed spice
instruction_lines: Mix the grated carrot, mixed spice and cinnamon with the oats, 100ml water and a pinch of salt, then cover and chill in the fridge overnight.
The next day, stir in the honey and sultanas, then top with Greek yogurt.
